source.text: בִּשְׁנַ֣ת חֲדָ֗ה לְבֵלְאשַׁצַּר֙ מֶ֣לֶךְ בָּבֶ֔ל דָּנִיֵּאל֙ חֵ֣לֶם חֲזָ֔ה וְחֶזְוֵ֥י רֵאשֵׁ֖הּ עַֽל־מִשְׁכְּבֵ֑הּ בֵּאדַ֨יִן֙ חֶלְמָ֣א כְתַ֔ב רֵ֥אשׁ מִלִּ֖ין אֲמַֽר׃

records.literal_gloss: In year one of Belshazzar king of Babylon, Daniel saw a dream and visions of his head upon his bed; then the dream he wrote; [the] head of [the] matters he told.

en.L: In the first year of Belshazzar king of Babylon, Daniel saw a dream and visions of his head, lying on his bed. Then he wrote the dream down; he told the sum of the matters.
en.B: In the first year of Belshazzar's reign over Babylon, Daniel had a dream, and as he lay in bed, visions came into his mind. Then he wrote the dream down and gave an account of the main things in it.
en.R: In Belshazzar's first year as king of Babylon, Daniel had a dream. As he lay on his bed, he saw visions in his mind. Then he wrote the dream down and told the most important parts of it.

fr.L: La première année de Belshatsar, roi de Babylone, Daniel vit un songe et des visions de sa tête, sur sa couche. Alors il écrivit le songe ; il en raconta l’essentiel.
fr.B: La première année du règne de Belshatsar sur Babylone, Daniel eut un songe, et des visions lui traversèrent l’esprit pendant qu’il était couché. Puis il mit le songe par écrit et en rapporta l’essentiel.
fr.R: Pendant la première année où Belshatsar était roi de Babylone, Daniel a fait un rêve. Pendant qu’il était couché sur son lit, il a vu des visions dans son esprit. Ensuite, il a écrit le rêve et il en a raconté les parties les plus importantes.

es.L: En el año primero de Belsasar, rey de Babilonia, Daniel vio un sueño y visiones de su cabeza estando en su cama. Luego escribió el sueño; relató lo principal de los asuntos.
es.B: En el primer año del reinado de Belsasar sobre Babilonia, Daniel tuvo un sueño, y mientras estaba acostado en su cama le vinieron visiones a la mente. Luego escribió el sueño y relató lo principal de él.
es.R: En el primer año en que Belsasar fue rey de Babilonia, Daniel tuvo un sueño. Mientras estaba acostado en su cama, vio visiones en su mente. Después escribió el sueño y contó las partes más importantes.

vi.L: Vào năm thứ nhất của Bên-xát-sa vua Ba-by-lôn, Đa-ni-ên thấy một giấc mộng và các khải tượng trong đầu ông khi nằm trên giường. Bấy giờ ông chép giấc mộng lại; ông thuật lại đại ý các việc ấy.
vi.B: Vào năm thứ nhất triều vua Bên-xát-sa nước Ba-by-lôn, Đa-ni-ên nằm mơ, và khi ông nằm trên giường thì có những khải tượng hiện ra trong trí ông. Rồi ông chép giấc mơ lại và thuật lại những điều chính yếu trong đó.
vi.R: Năm đầu tiên Bên-xát-sa làm vua Ba-by-lôn, Đa-ni-ên có một giấc mơ. Khi ông nằm trên giường, ông thấy những khải tượng trong trí. Rồi ông chép giấc mơ lại và kể những phần quan trọng nhất của nó.

ko.L: 바빌론 왕 벨사살 원년에 다니엘이 그의 침상 위에서 꿈과 그의 머리의 환상들을 보았다. 그때에 그는 그 꿈을 기록하고, 그 일들의 요점을 말했다.
ko.B: 벨사살이 바빌론을 다스린 첫해에, 다니엘이 꿈을 꾸었다. 그가 침상에 누워 있을 때 머릿속에 환상들이 떠올랐다. 그는 그 꿈을 기록하고, 그 요점을 이야기했다.
ko.R: 벨사살이 바빌론 왕이 된 첫해에 다니엘이 꿈을 꾸었다. 그는 침상에 누워 있을 때 머릿속으로 환상들을 보았다. 그는 그 꿈을 적어 두고, 가장 중요한 내용을 이야기했다.

decisions.choice: the first year of Belshazzar: some years before the fall of Babylon told in chapter 5
decisions.reason: Belshazzar was the son of Nabonidus, the last king of Babylon, and ruled in Babylon while his father stayed away in Arabia, from about 550 BC. Babylon fell to the Persians in 539 BC, on the night told in chapter 5. So this chapter, and chapter 8 (dated in Belshazzar's third year), go back in time before chapters 5 and 6. The book arranges its visions in their own order, after the stories.

decisions.choice: the vision is still written in Aramaic
decisions.reason: The Aramaic that began at 2:4 runs on through this chapter to 7:28. The vision of four beasts stands in the same language as Nebuchadnezzar's dream of a statue made of four metals (chapter 2), and the two chapters, which both tell of four kingdoms followed by God's kingdom, frame the Aramaic part of the book. The book returns to Hebrew at 8:1.

decisions.choice: visions of his head: visions that passed through his mind
decisions.reason: The "head" is where dreams and thoughts are seen, as in 2:28 and 4:2, 7. Daniel saw these things in a dream at night, as he lay asleep.

decisions.choice: he told the head of the matters: he gave the substance of what he saw
alternatives: the beginning of the account; he said:
decisions.reason: The "head" of the matters is their chief part or sum. The last verb is the ordinary word "said", used here for telling the account. It may also introduce what follows: "the beginning of the account, he said". Either way, verses 2-28 are Daniel's own account in his own words.

decisions.choice: in the first year of Belshazzar's reign (B); in Belshazzar's first year as king (R)
decisions.reason: The date follows the wording set for dated headings in Jeremiah. Balanced and Readable say that the visions were in his mind (m3), and Readable divides the long sentence.

decisions.choice: narration in the passé simple at Literal and Balanced and the passé composé at Readable; from 7:2 Daniel tells his vision in the first person with the same split ("je regardais", "je vis" / "j'ai vu")
alternatives: passé composé at every level for Daniel's own account
decisions.reason: As the term sheet asks for Daniel 7-12 and the other first-person visions; the imparfait "je regardais" renders the Aramaic "I was seeing" of a vision watched over time.

source.text: עָנֵ֤ה דָנִיֵּאל֙ וְאָמַ֔ר חָזֵ֥ה הֲוֵ֛ית בְּחֶזְוִ֖י עִם־לֵֽילְיָ֑א וַאֲר֗וּ אַרְבַּע֙ רוּחֵ֣י שְׁמַיָּ֔א מְגִיחָ֖ן לְיַמָּ֥א רַבָּֽא׃

records.literal_gloss: Answering Daniel and saying, seeing I was in my vision with the night, and look, four [the] winds of the heavens stirring up the sea the great.

en.L: Daniel answered and said: I was looking in my vision by night, and look, the four winds of the heavens were stirring up the great sea.
en.B: Daniel said: In my vision at night I looked, and I saw the four winds of heaven churning up the great sea.
en.R: This is what Daniel said: In my vision during the night, I saw strong winds blowing from every direction. They were stirring up the great sea.

fr.L: Daniel répondit et dit : Je regardais dans ma vision, pendant la nuit, et voici, les quatre vents des cieux agitaient la grande mer.
fr.B: Daniel dit : Je regardais, dans ma vision pendant la nuit, et je vis les quatre vents du ciel soulever la grande mer.
fr.R: Voici ce que Daniel a raconté : Dans ma vision, pendant la nuit, j’ai vu des vents violents qui soufflaient de tous les côtés. Ils agitaient la grande mer.

es.L: Daniel respondió y dijo: Estaba yo mirando en mi visión de noche, y he aquí, los cuatro vientos de los cielos agitaban el gran mar.
es.B: Daniel dijo: En mi visión de noche miré, y vi que los cuatro vientos del cielo agitaban el gran mar.
es.R: Esto es lo que contó Daniel: En mi visión durante la noche, vi vientos fuertes que soplaban de todas direcciones. Agitaban el gran mar.

vi.L: Đa-ni-ên đáp và nói: Tôi đang nhìn trong khải tượng ban đêm, và kìa, bốn ngọn gió của trời đang khuấy động biển lớn.
vi.B: Đa-ni-ên kể: Trong khải tượng ban đêm, tôi nhìn và thấy bốn ngọn gió của trời đang khuấy động biển lớn.
vi.R: Đây là điều Đa-ni-ên kể: Trong khải tượng ban đêm, tôi thấy những trận gió mạnh thổi đến từ mọi hướng. Chúng làm cho biển lớn nổi sóng dữ dội.

ko.L: 다니엘이 대답하여 말했다. 내가 밤에 내 환상 가운데 보고 있었는데, 보라, 하늘의 네 바람이 큰 바다를 휘젓고 있었다.
ko.B: 다니엘이 말했다. 내가 밤에 환상 가운데 보니, 하늘의 네 바람이 큰 바다를 휘몰아치고 있었다.
ko.R: 다니엘이 한 말은 이러하다. 밤에 나는 환상 가운데 사방에서 거센 바람이 불어오는 것을 보았다. 그 바람이 큰 바다를 뒤흔들고 있었다.

decisions.choice: answered and said: began to speak
decisions.reason: The pair of verbs is a common way of introducing speech in the Aramaic of Daniel (2:5; 3:14). There is no question being answered. From here on Daniel tells the vision in his own words, in the first person.

decisions.choice: I was looking: I kept watching, over a span of time
decisions.reason: The participle with the verb "to be" describes looking that went on. The same phrase marks each new step of the vision (verses 4, 6, 7, 9, 11, 13, 21).

decisions.choice: the four winds of heaven stirring up the great sea: storms from every side whipping up the sea
decisions.reason: The four winds are the winds from the four directions, so the whole sky. The great sea may be the Mediterranean, which has that name (Numbers 34:6), but in the vision it is the restless deep, which in Hebrew poetry stands for the forces that oppose God (Isaiah 17:12-13; 27:1; Psalm 74:13). The beasts come up out of it.

decisions.choice: look (L); I saw (B, R)
decisions.reason: Literal keeps "look", the word that marks something seen in a vision, as in Zechariah. Balanced and Readable say "I saw". Readable says "strong winds blowing from every direction" for the four winds (m3), and Daniel's account is not set in quotation marks, since it runs on as his own telling of the vision to the end of the chapter.

decisions.choice: "he aquí" (L); "vi" (B, R)
decisions.reason: The vision formula of these books: L "Miré, y he aquí ...", B "Miré y vi ...", R "Vi ..."; used through Daniel 7–12

decisions.choice: Daniel tells the vision as "tôi", with no quotation marks
decisions.reason: From here to the end of the chapter Daniel speaks in the first person, as the English sets it, without quotation marks; the interpreter's words in verses 17-27 take double quotes. The beasts are "con thú" at every level, as Revelation 13:1 publishes them.

decisions.choice: Daniel tells his visions in the first person in the plain written style with "나", with no quotation marks, and gives God -시- (chapters 7-12)
decisions.reason: The term sheet sets the narrator of Daniel 7-12 in the plain style, honouring God; the English sets the account as narration, not quoted speech.

source.text: וְאַרְבַּ֤ע חֵיוָן֙ רַבְרְבָ֔ן סָלְקָ֖ן מִן־יַמָּ֑א שָׁנְיָ֖ן דָּ֥א מִן־דָּֽא׃

records.literal_gloss: And four beasts great coming up from the sea, different this from this.

en.L: And four great beasts were coming up from the sea, different from one another.
en.B: Four huge beasts rose out of the sea, each unlike the others.
en.R: Four huge animals came up out of the sea. Each one was different from the others.

fr.L: Et quatre grandes bêtes montaient de la mer, différentes l’une de l’autre.
fr.B: Quatre bêtes énormes sortirent de la mer, toutes différentes les unes des autres.
fr.R: Quatre animaux énormes sont sortis de la mer. Chacun était différent des autres.

es.L: Y cuatro grandes bestias subían del mar, diferentes la una de la otra.
es.B: Cuatro bestias enormes salieron del mar, cada una distinta de las demás.
es.R: Cuatro animales enormes salieron del mar. Cada uno era distinto de los otros.

vi.L: Và bốn con thú lớn từ biển đi lên, con này khác con kia.
vi.B: Bốn con thú khổng lồ từ dưới biển đi lên, con nào cũng khác những con kia.
vi.R: Bốn con thú khổng lồ từ dưới biển đi lên. Con nào cũng khác những con kia.

ko.L: 그리고 큰 짐승 넷이 바다에서 올라오고 있었는데, 서로 달랐다.
ko.B: 그러자 큰 짐승 네 마리가 바다에서 올라왔는데, 모양이 저마다 달랐다.
ko.R: 큰 짐승 네 마리가 바다에서 올라왔다. 짐승마다 모양이 서로 달랐다.

decisions.choice: four great beasts from the sea: taken up in Revelation 13
decisions.reason: Revelation 13:1-2 sees one beast rising from the sea with ten horns, like a leopard, with feet like a bear's and a mouth like a lion's: the four beasts of Daniel 7 joined in one. Verse 17 says that the beasts are four kings.

decisions.choice: animals (R)
decisions.reason: Readable says "animals" for "beasts"; the word is the ordinary word for a wild animal.

decisions.choice: "bête(s)" (Literal, Balanced), "animal" (Readable); "corne(s)", "une petite corne", "royaume(s)", for the whole chapter
decisions.reason: As Revelation 13 in the published French, which takes up this vision; Readable follows the English "animals".

decisions.choice: "bestias" (L, B); "animales" (R)
decisions.reason: As Revelation 13:1 ("una bestia que subía del mar") at L and B; plain "animales" at R, as the English R

decisions.choice: "짐승" at every level
decisions.reason: The term sheet keeps "짐승" for the beasts of the visions at every level, as Revelation 13 does; the word is plain enough for Readable.

source.text: קַדְמָיְתָ֣א כְאַרְיֵ֔ה וְגַפִּ֥ין דִּֽי־נְשַׁ֖ר לַ֑הּ חָזֵ֣ה הֲוֵ֡ית עַד֩ דִּי־מְּרִ֨יטוּ גַפַּ֜יהּ וּנְטִ֣ילַת מִן־אַרְעָ֗א וְעַל־רַגְלַ֨יִן֙ כֶּאֱנָ֣שׁ הֳקִימַ֔ת וּלְבַ֥ב אֱנָ֖שׁ יְהִ֥יב לַֽהּ׃

records.literal_gloss: The first [was] like a lion, and wings of an eagle [were] to it; seeing I was until that were plucked off its wings, and it was lifted up from the earth and on two feet like a man it was made to stand, and a heart of a man was given to it.

en.L: The first was like a lion and had the wings of an eagle. I kept looking until its wings were plucked off, and it was lifted from the earth and set upright on two feet like a human, and a human heart was given to it.
en.B: The first was like a lion, and it had eagle's wings. As I watched, its wings were torn off, and it was lifted from the ground and set on two feet like a human being, and it was given a human mind.
en.R: The first animal looked like a lion, but it had wings like an eagle. As I watched, its wings were pulled off. It was lifted off the ground and made to stand up on two feet like a person. It was given a human mind.

fr.L: La première était comme un lion et avait des ailes d’aigle. Je regardais, jusqu’au moment où ses ailes furent arrachées, et elle fut soulevée de terre et dressée sur deux pieds comme un homme, et un cœur d’homme lui fut donné.
fr.B: La première ressemblait à un lion et avait des ailes d’aigle. Pendant que je regardais, ses ailes furent arrachées ; elle fut soulevée de terre et mise debout sur deux pieds comme un être humain, et elle reçut un esprit humain.
fr.R: Le premier animal ressemblait à un lion, mais il avait des ailes comme un aigle. Pendant que je regardais, on lui a arraché ses ailes. On l’a soulevé de terre et on l’a fait tenir debout sur deux pieds comme une personne. On lui a donné un esprit humain.

es.L: La primera era como un león y tenía alas de águila. Estuve mirando hasta que le fueron arrancadas las alas, y fue levantada de la tierra y puesta en pie sobre dos pies como un hombre, y le fue dado corazón de hombre.
es.B: La primera era como un león y tenía alas de águila. Mientras yo miraba, le arrancaron las alas, y fue levantada del suelo y puesta sobre dos pies como un ser humano, y se le dio una mente humana.
es.R: El primer animal parecía un león, pero tenía alas como de águila. Mientras yo miraba, le arrancaron las alas. Lo levantaron del suelo y lo hicieron ponerse de pie sobre dos pies como una persona. Se le dio una mente humana.

vi.L: Con thứ nhất giống như sư tử và có cánh của chim đại bàng. Tôi cứ nhìn cho đến khi cánh nó bị nhổ đi, và nó được nhấc lên khỏi đất và được dựng đứng trên hai chân như một con người, và được ban cho lòng của loài người.
vi.B: Con thứ nhất giống như sư tử và có cánh chim đại bàng. Trong khi tôi nhìn, cánh nó bị nhổ đi, rồi nó được nhấc lên khỏi mặt đất, được dựng đứng trên hai chân như một con người, và được ban cho lòng trí của loài người.
vi.R: Con thú thứ nhất trông giống như sư tử, nhưng có cánh như chim đại bàng. Trong khi tôi nhìn, cánh nó bị nhổ đi. Nó được nhấc lên khỏi mặt đất và được dựng đứng trên hai chân như một người. Nó được ban cho trí óc của loài người.

ko.L: 첫째는 사자 같았고 독수리의 날개가 있었다. 내가 보고 있었는데, 마침내 그 날개들이 뽑혔고, 그것이 땅에서 들려서 사람처럼 두 발로 서게 되었으며, 사람의 마음이 그것에게 주어졌다.
ko.B: 첫째 짐승은 사자처럼 생겼는데, 독수리의 날개가 있었다. 내가 보고 있는 동안 그 날개가 뽑히더니, 그 짐승이 땅에서 들려 사람처럼 두 발로 서게 되었고, 사람의 마음을 받았다.
ko.R: 첫째 짐승은 사자처럼 생겼는데, 독수리 같은 날개가 있었다. 내가 보고 있는 동안 그 날개가 뽑혔다. 그 짐승은 땅에서 들려 사람처럼 두 발로 서게 되었다. 그리고 사람의 마음을 받았다.

decisions.choice: a lion with eagle's wings: the usual reading is the kingdom of Babylon
decisions.reason: Glazed lions lined the processional way of Babylon, winged lions are common in the art of Mesopotamia, and the prophets compare Nebuchadnezzar to a lion and an eagle (Jeremiah 4:7; 49:19, 22; Ezekiel 17:3). The first part of the statue in chapter 2, the head of gold, is Babylon (2:38). The vision itself names no kingdom.

decisions.choice: made to stand like a human, given a human heart: a beast made humane
decisions.reason: The lion is humbled and then given a human heart, the reverse of what happened to Nebuchadnezzar, who was given the heart of an animal until he acknowledged the Most High (4:13, 31-33). Many readers see his story behind this picture.

decisions.choice: a human heart: a human mind and understanding
decisions.reason: In Aramaic as in Hebrew the heart is the seat of thinking and will, not chiefly of feeling (4:13).

decisions.choice: like a human; a human heart (L); a human mind (B, R)
decisions.reason: The word means a human being, not a male, so every level says "human" or "person". Balanced and Readable say "mind" for heart (m3).

source.text: וַאֲר֣וּ חֵיוָה֩ אָחֳרִ֨י תִנְיָנָ֜ה דָּמְיָ֣ה לְדֹ֗ב וְלִשְׂטַר־חַד֙ הֳקִמַ֔ת וּתְלָ֥ת עִלְעִ֛ין בְּפֻמַּ֖הּ בֵּ֣ין שִׁנַּ֑הּ וְכֵן֙ אָמְרִ֣ין לַ֔הּ ק֥וּמִֽי אֲכֻ֖לִי בְּשַׂ֥ר שַׂגִּֽיא׃

records.literal_gloss: And look, a beast another, a second, resembling a bear, and to a side one it was raised, and three ribs [were] in its mouth between its teeth, and thus [they were] saying to it: Arise, devour flesh much.

en.L: And look, another beast, a second one, like a bear. It was raised on one side, with three ribs in its mouth between its teeth; and thus they were saying to it, "Arise, devour much flesh."
en.B: Then I saw another beast, a second one, that looked like a bear. It was raised up on one side, and it had three ribs in its mouth between its teeth. It was told, "Get up and eat your fill of flesh!"
en.R: Then I saw a second animal. It looked like a bear. It was raised up on one side, and it had three ribs in its mouth between its teeth. Someone told it, "Get up and eat as much meat as you want!"

fr.L: Et voici une autre bête, une deuxième, semblable à un ours. Elle était dressée sur un côté, et trois côtes [étaient] dans sa gueule, entre ses dents ; et on lui disait ainsi : « Lève-toi, dévore beaucoup de chair. »
fr.B: Puis je vis une autre bête, une deuxième, qui ressemblait à un ours. Elle se dressait sur un côté et tenait trois côtes dans sa gueule, entre ses dents. On lui dit : « Lève-toi, et mange de la chair tant que tu voudras ! »
fr.R: Ensuite, j’ai vu un deuxième animal. Il ressemblait à un ours. Il se dressait sur un côté, et il avait trois côtes dans la gueule, entre les dents. Quelqu’un lui a dit : « Lève-toi et mange autant de viande que tu veux ! »

es.L: Y he aquí otra bestia, la segunda, semejante a un oso, que se alzaba de un costado, y tenía tres costillas en la boca entre sus dientes; y así le decían: «Levántate, devora mucha carne».
es.B: Luego vi otra bestia, la segunda, que parecía un oso. Estaba alzada sobre un costado y tenía tres costillas en la boca, entre los dientes. Y se le dijo: «¡Levántate y come carne hasta hartarte!».
es.R: Luego vi un segundo animal. Parecía un oso. Estaba levantado de un lado, y tenía tres costillas en la boca, entre los dientes. Alguien le dijo: «¡Levántate y come toda la carne que quieras!».

vi.L: Và kìa, một con thú khác, con thứ hai, giống như con gấu. Nó được nhổm lên một bên, và có ba xương sườn trong miệng nó giữa các răng nó; và người ta nói với nó như vầy: "Hãy đứng dậy, ăn nhiều thịt."
vi.B: Rồi tôi thấy một con thú khác, con thứ hai, trông giống như con gấu. Nó nhổm lên một bên, và trong miệng giữa các răng có ba xương sườn. Có tiếng bảo nó: "Hãy đứng dậy, ăn thịt cho no nê!"
vi.R: Rồi tôi thấy con thú thứ hai. Nó trông giống như con gấu. Nó nhổm lên một bên, và trong miệng nó, giữa các răng, có ba xương sườn. Có ai đó bảo nó: "Hãy đứng dậy và ăn thịt bao nhiêu tùy thích!"

ko.L: 그리고 보라, 다른 짐승, 곧 둘째 짐승이 곰 같았다. 그것은 한쪽으로 일으켜 세워져 있었고, 그 입의 이빨 사이에는 갈빗대 세 개가 물려 있었다. 그리고 사람들이 그것에게 이렇게 말하고 있었다. "일어나서 많은 고기를 먹어라."
ko.B: 또 보니, 둘째 짐승은 곰처럼 생겼다. 그 짐승은 몸 한쪽을 일으키고 있었고, 입에는 이빨 사이에 갈빗대 세 개를 물고 있었다. 그 짐승에게 이런 말이 들렸다. "일어나서 고기를 실컷 먹어라!"
ko.R: 그다음에 나는 둘째 짐승을 보았다. 그것은 곰처럼 생겼다. 그 짐승은 몸 한쪽을 일으키고 있었고, 입에는 이빨 사이에 갈빗대 세 개를 물고 있었다. 누군가 그 짐승에게 말했다. "일어나서 고기를 마음껏 먹어라!"

decisions.choice: raised up on one side: rearing up on one side, or with one side higher
decisions.reason: The picture may be of a bear lifting itself on one side, ready to spring, or of a body higher on one side than the other. The usual reading of the second kingdom as Media, or as Media and Persia, has taken it as the stronger Persian side of a joint empire (8:3, 20). The vision does not explain it.

decisions.choice: a bear with three ribs in its mouth: a second kingdom that devours others
decisions.reason: The ribs are the remains of prey. They are usually read as three lands it has conquered. The second kingdom is read as Media (in the reading that takes the four kingdoms as Babylon, Media, Persia and Greece) or as Medo-Persia (in the reading that takes them as Babylon, Medo-Persia, Greece and Rome); see verse 17.

decisions.choice: thus they were saying to it: it was told
decisions.reason: The plural verb has no stated subject. In the Aramaic of Daniel this is a common way of saying that something was said or done without naming who did it (4:22, 29). The command to devour comes from heaven, where the kingdoms are given their power.

decisions.choice: It was told (B); Someone told it (R)
decisions.reason: Literal keeps "they were saying"; Balanced and Readable say it without an unnamed "they" (m3).

source.text: בָּאתַ֨ר דְּנָ֜ה חָזֵ֣ה הֲוֵ֗ית וַאֲר֤וּ אָֽחֳרִי֙ כִּנְמַ֔ר וְלַ֨הּ גַּפִּ֥ין אַרְבַּ֛ע דִּי־ע֖וֹף עַל־גַּבַּ֑הּ וְאַרְבְּעָ֤ה רֵאשִׁין֙ לְחֵ֣יוְתָ֔א וְשָׁלְטָ֖ן יְהִ֥יב לַֽהּ׃

records.literal_gloss: After this seeing I was, and look, another, like a leopard, and to it wings four of a bird upon its back, and four heads [were] to the beast, and dominion was given to it.

en.L: After this I kept looking, and look, another, like a leopard, and it had four wings of a bird on its back; and the beast had four heads, and dominion was given to it.
en.B: After that, as I watched, I saw another beast, like a leopard. On its back it had four wings like a bird's, and the beast had four heads. It was given authority to rule.
en.R: After that, I saw another animal. It looked like a leopard, and it had four wings like a bird's on its back. This animal had four heads, and it was given power to rule.

fr.L: Après cela je regardais, et voici une autre [bête], semblable à un léopard, et elle avait sur le dos quatre ailes d’oiseau ; et la bête avait quatre têtes, et la domination lui fut donnée.
fr.B: Après cela, tandis que je regardais, je vis une autre bête, semblable à un léopard. Elle avait sur le dos quatre ailes d’oiseau, et cette bête avait quatre têtes. Le pouvoir de dominer lui fut donné.
fr.R: Après cela, j’ai vu un autre animal. Il ressemblait à un léopard, et il avait sur le dos quatre ailes comme celles d’un oiseau. Cet animal avait quatre têtes, et il a reçu le pouvoir de régner.

es.L: Después de esto estuve mirando, y he aquí otra, semejante a un leopardo, que tenía sobre su espalda cuatro alas de ave; y la bestia tenía cuatro cabezas, y le fue dado dominio.
es.B: Después de esto, mientras yo miraba, vi otra bestia, semejante a un leopardo. Tenía en la espalda cuatro alas como de ave, y la bestia tenía cuatro cabezas. Se le dio autoridad para gobernar.
es.R: Después de eso vi otro animal. Parecía un leopardo, y tenía en la espalda cuatro alas como de ave. Este animal tenía cuatro cabezas, y se le dio poder para gobernar.

vi.L: Sau đó tôi cứ nhìn, và kìa, một con khác giống như con beo, và nó có bốn cánh chim trên lưng; và con thú có bốn đầu, và quyền thống trị được ban cho nó.
vi.B: Sau đó, trong khi tôi nhìn, tôi thấy một con thú khác giống như con beo. Trên lưng nó có bốn cánh như cánh chim, và con thú ấy có bốn đầu. Nó được ban cho quyền cai trị.
vi.R: Sau đó, tôi thấy một con thú khác. Nó trông giống như con beo, và trên lưng có bốn cánh như cánh chim. Con thú này có bốn đầu, và nó được ban cho quyền cai trị.

ko.L: 이 뒤에 내가 보고 있었는데, 보라, 표범 같은 다른 [짐승이 있었다]. 그 등에는 새의 날개 넷이 있었고, 그 짐승에게는 머리가 넷 있었으며, 그것에게 통치권이 주어졌다.
ko.B: 그 뒤에 내가 또 보니, 표범처럼 생긴 다른 짐승이 있었다. 그 등에는 새의 날개 같은 날개가 넷 있었고, 머리도 넷이었다. 그 짐승은 다스리는 권세를 받았다.
ko.R: 그 뒤에 나는 또 다른 짐승을 보았다. 그것은 표범처럼 생겼고, 등에는 새의 날개 같은 날개가 넷 있었다. 이 짐승은 머리가 넷이었다. 그리고 다스리는 힘을 받았다.

decisions.choice: a leopard with four wings and four heads: a swift kingdom
decisions.reason: The leopard is fast, and the wings make it faster. In the reading that takes the four kingdoms as Babylon, Media, Persia and Greece, it is Persia, whose four kings are named in 11:2; in the reading that takes them as Babylon, Medo-Persia, Greece and Rome, it is Greece, whose empire was divided among four after Alexander (8:8, 22). The vision does not name it; see verse 17.

decisions.choice: dominion was given to it: it was allowed to rule
decisions.reason: The passive verb, as in verse 4, implies that God gives each kingdom its rule (2:21, 37; 4:14).

decisions.choice: authority to rule (B); power to rule (R)
decisions.reason: The noun means rule or dominion. Balanced and Readable use plain words for it here and in verses 12, 14, 26 and 27; Literal keeps "dominion".

source.text: בָּאתַ֣ר דְּנָה֩ חָזֵ֨ה הֲוֵ֜ית בְּחֶזְוֵ֣י לֵֽילְיָ֗א וַאֲר֣וּ חֵיוָ֣ה רְֽבִיעָאָ֡ה דְּחִילָה֩ וְאֵֽימְתָנִ֨י וְתַקִּיפָ֜א יַתִּ֗ירָא וְשִׁנַּ֨יִן דִּֽי־פַרְזֶ֥ל לַהּ֙ רַבְרְבָ֔ן אָֽכְלָ֣ה וּמַדֱּקָ֔ה וּשְׁאָרָ֖א בְּרַגְלַ֣הּ רָפְסָ֑ה וְהִ֣יא מְשַׁנְּיָ֗ה מִן־כָּל־חֵֽיוָתָא֙ דִּ֣י קָֽדָמַ֔יהּ וְקַרְנַ֥יִן עֲשַׂ֖ר לַֽהּ׃

records.literal_gloss: After this seeing I was in visions of the night, and look, a beast fourth, dreadful and terrible and strong exceedingly, and teeth of iron [were] to it, great; [it was] devouring and crushing, and the rest with its feet trampling; and it [was] different from all the beasts that [were] before it, and horns ten [were] to it.

en.L: After this I kept looking in the visions of the night, and look, a fourth beast, dreadful and terrible and exceedingly strong. It had great teeth of iron; it was devouring and crushing, and trampling what was left with its feet. It was different from all the beasts that came before it, and it had ten horns.
en.B: After that, in my visions at night, I saw a fourth beast, terrifying, frightening and very strong. It had huge iron teeth. It devoured and crushed its victims, and trampled what was left under its feet. It was unlike all the beasts before it, and it had ten horns.
en.R: After that, in my visions during the night, I saw a fourth animal. It was terrifying and frightening and very strong. It had huge teeth made of iron. It ate and crushed its victims, and it stamped on whatever was left. It was not like any of the animals before it, and it had ten horns.

fr.L: Après cela je regardais dans les visions de la nuit, et voici une quatrième bête, effrayante, terrible et extraordinairement forte. Elle avait de grandes dents de fer ; elle dévorait et broyait, et elle piétinait le reste de ses pieds. Elle était différente de toutes les bêtes qui l’avaient précédée, et elle avait dix cornes.
fr.B: Après cela, dans mes visions de la nuit, je vis une quatrième bête, terrifiante, effrayante et d’une force extraordinaire. Elle avait d’énormes dents de fer. Elle dévorait et broyait ses victimes, et piétinait ce qui restait. Elle ne ressemblait à aucune des bêtes qui l’avaient précédée, et elle avait dix cornes.
fr.R: Après cela, dans mes visions pendant la nuit, j’ai vu un quatrième animal. Il était terrifiant, effrayant et très fort. Il avait d’énormes dents en fer. Il mangeait et broyait ses victimes, et il écrasait de ses pieds tout ce qui restait. Il ne ressemblait à aucun des animaux d’avant, et il avait dix cornes.

es.L: Después de esto estuve mirando en las visiones de la noche, y he aquí una cuarta bestia, espantosa y terrible y en gran manera fuerte. Tenía grandes dientes de hierro; devoraba y desmenuzaba, y lo que quedaba lo pisoteaba con sus pies. Era diferente de todas las bestias que habían venido antes de ella, y tenía diez cuernos.
es.B: Después de esto, en mis visiones de la noche, vi una cuarta bestia, aterradora, espantosa y muy fuerte. Tenía enormes dientes de hierro. Devoraba y despedazaba a sus víctimas, y pisoteaba con sus patas lo que quedaba. Era diferente de todas las bestias anteriores, y tenía diez cuernos.
es.R: Después de eso, en mis visiones durante la noche, vi un cuarto animal. Era aterrador, espantoso y muy fuerte. Tenía enormes dientes de hierro. Se comía y destrozaba a sus víctimas, y aplastaba con las patas lo que quedaba. No se parecía a ninguno de los animales anteriores, y tenía diez cuernos.

vi.L: Sau đó tôi cứ nhìn trong các khải tượng ban đêm, và kìa, một con thú thứ tư, đáng sợ, kinh khiếp và vô cùng mạnh mẽ. Nó có những răng lớn bằng sắt; nó cắn nuốt và nghiền nát, và giày đạp phần còn lại dưới chân nó. Nó khác với tất cả các con thú trước nó, và nó có mười sừng.
vi.B: Sau đó, trong các khải tượng ban đêm, tôi thấy một con thú thứ tư, đáng sợ, kinh khiếp và rất mạnh. Nó có những răng lớn bằng sắt. Nó cắn nuốt và nghiền nát những gì nó bắt được, rồi giày đạp phần còn lại dưới chân. Nó khác hẳn tất cả các con thú trước nó, và nó có mười sừng.
vi.R: Sau đó, trong các khải tượng ban đêm, tôi thấy một con thú thứ tư. Nó rất đáng sợ, kinh khiếp và rất mạnh. Nó có những cái răng khổng lồ bằng sắt. Nó ăn và nghiền nát những gì nó bắt được, rồi giẫm nát những gì còn lại. Nó không giống bất cứ con thú nào trước nó, và nó có mười sừng.

ko.L: 이 뒤에 내가 밤의 환상들 가운데 보고 있었는데, 보라, 넷째 짐승이 있었다. 그것은 무섭고 끔찍하며 매우 강했다. 그것에게는 큰 쇠 이빨이 있었다. 그것은 먹고 부수며 나머지는 그 발로 짓밟았다. 그것은 그 전에 있던 모든 짐승과 달랐고, 뿔이 열 개 있었다.
ko.B: 그 뒤에 내가 밤의 환상 가운데 보니, 넷째 짐승이 있었다. 그 짐승은 무섭고 끔찍하며 아주 강했다. 그 짐승에게는 커다란 쇠 이빨이 있어서, 먹이를 삼키고 부수며 남은 것은 발로 짓밟았다. 그것은 앞의 모든 짐승과 달랐고, 뿔이 열 개 있었다.
ko.R: 그 뒤에 나는 밤의 환상 가운데 넷째 짐승을 보았다. 그 짐승은 무섭고 끔찍하며 아주 강했다. 그 짐승에게는 쇠로 된 커다란 이빨이 있었다. 그것은 먹이를 삼키고 부수었고, 남은 것은 발로 짓밟았다. 그것은 앞의 다른 짐승들과 전혀 달랐다. 그리고 뿔이 열 개 있었다.

decisions.choice: the fourth beast: not like any known animal
decisions.reason: Daniel compares the first three beasts to a lion, a bear and a leopard, but the fourth he can only describe. Its iron teeth recall the legs of iron of the statue in chapter 2, the fourth kingdom that crushes all the others (2:40). Verse 23 says it is a fourth kingdom. In the reading that takes the four kingdoms as Babylon, Media, Persia and Greece, it is the Greek kingdom of Alexander and his successors; in the reading that takes them as Babylon, Medo-Persia, Greece and Rome, it is Rome. See verse 17.

decisions.choice: ten horns: ten kings (verse 24)
decisions.reason: A horn is an animal's strength, and so stands for a king's power (8:20-22; Zechariah 2:1-4). The angel explains the ten horns as ten kings who arise from this kingdom (verse 24).

decisions.choice: a beast with ten horns: Revelation 12:3; 13:1; 17:3, 12
decisions.reason: Revelation gives ten horns to the dragon and to the beast from the sea, and explains them, as Daniel's angel does, as ten kings (Revelation 17:12).

decisions.choice: its victims (B, R)
decisions.reason: The Aramaic leaves the object of devouring and crushing to be understood; Balanced and Readable supply "its victims".

source.text: מִשְׂתַּכַּ֨ל הֲוֵ֜ית בְּקַרְנַיָּ֗א וַ֠אֲלוּ קֶ֣רֶן אָחֳרִ֤י זְעֵירָה֙ סִלְקָ֣ת בֵּֽינֵיהֵ֔ן וּתְלָ֗ת מִן־קַרְנַיָּא֙ קַדְמָ֣יָתָ֔א אֶתְעֲקַ֖רָה מִן־קֳדָמַ֑הּ וַאֲל֨וּ עַיְנִ֜ין כְּעַיְנֵ֤י אֲנָשָׁא֙ בְּקַרְנָא־דָ֔א וּפֻ֖ם מְמַלִּ֥ל רַבְרְבָֽן׃

records.literal_gloss: Considering I was the horns, and look, a horn another, small, came up between them, and three of the horns the first were uprooted from before it; and look, eyes like eyes of a man [were] in the horn this, and a mouth speaking great [things].

en.L: I was considering the horns, and look, another horn, a small one, came up among them, and three of the former horns were uprooted before it. And look, in this horn were eyes like human eyes, and a mouth speaking great things.
en.B: While I was studying the horns, another horn, a small one, grew up among them, and three of the earlier horns were pulled up by the roots to make room for it. This horn had eyes like a human's eyes and a mouth that spoke boastfully.
en.R: While I was thinking about the horns, I saw another horn come up among them. It was a small horn. Three of the first horns were pulled out to make room for it. This small horn had eyes like a person's eyes, and it had a mouth that was boasting.

fr.L: Je considérais les cornes, et voici, une autre corne, petite, monta au milieu d’elles, et trois des premières cornes furent arrachées devant elle. Et voici, dans cette corne [il y avait] des yeux comme des yeux d’homme, et une bouche qui disait de grandes choses.
fr.B: Tandis que j’examinais les cornes, une autre corne, une petite, poussa au milieu d’elles, et trois des premières cornes furent arrachées pour lui faire place. Cette corne avait des yeux semblables à des yeux humains et une bouche qui parlait avec arrogance.
fr.R: Pendant que je réfléchissais à ces cornes, j’ai vu une autre corne pousser au milieu d’elles. C’était une petite corne. Trois des premières cornes ont été arrachées pour lui faire de la place. Cette petite corne avait des yeux comme ceux d’une personne, et une bouche qui se vantait.

es.L: Estaba yo contemplando los cuernos, y he aquí que otro cuerno, uno pequeño, salió entre ellos, y tres de los primeros cuernos fueron arrancados delante de él. Y he aquí, en este cuerno había ojos como ojos de hombre, y una boca que hablaba grandes cosas.
es.B: Mientras yo observaba los cuernos, otro cuerno, uno pequeño, brotó entre ellos, y tres de los primeros cuernos fueron arrancados de raíz para dejarle lugar. Este cuerno tenía ojos como los de un ser humano y una boca que hablaba con arrogancia.
es.R: Mientras yo pensaba en los cuernos, vi que otro cuerno salía entre ellos. Era un cuerno pequeño. Tres de los primeros cuernos fueron arrancados para dejarle lugar. Este cuerno pequeño tenía ojos como los de una persona, y tenía una boca que hablaba con orgullo.

vi.L: Tôi đang suy xét các sừng, và kìa, một sừng khác, một cái sừng nhỏ, mọc lên giữa chúng, và ba trong các sừng trước bị nhổ bật rễ trước nó. Và kìa, trong sừng này có mắt như mắt người, và một cái miệng nói những điều lớn lối.
vi.B: Trong khi tôi đang xem xét các sừng, thì một sừng khác, một cái sừng nhỏ, mọc lên giữa chúng, và ba trong các sừng trước bị nhổ bật rễ để nhường chỗ cho nó. Sừng này có mắt như mắt người và một cái miệng nói những lời khoác lác.
vi.R: Trong khi tôi đang suy nghĩ về các sừng ấy, tôi thấy một sừng khác mọc lên giữa chúng. Đó là một cái sừng nhỏ. Ba trong các sừng đầu tiên bị nhổ ra để nhường chỗ cho nó. Cái sừng nhỏ này có mắt như mắt người, và có một cái miệng đang nói những lời khoác lác.

ko.L: 내가 그 뿔들을 살펴보고 있었는데, 보라, 다른 뿔, 작은 뿔 하나가 그것들 사이에서 올라왔고, 그것 앞에서 처음 뿔들 가운데 셋이 뿌리째 뽑혔다. 그리고 보라, 이 뿔에는 사람의 눈 같은 눈들이 있었고, 큰 것들을 말하는 입이 있었다.
ko.B: 내가 그 뿔들을 자세히 보고 있는데, 다른 작은 뿔 하나가 그 사이에서 돋아났다. 그리고 그 뿔에게 자리를 내주려고 먼저 있던 뿔 가운데 셋이 뿌리째 뽑혔다. 이 뿔에는 사람의 눈 같은 눈들이 있었고, 큰소리치는 입이 있었다.
ko.R: 내가 그 뿔들을 보며 생각하고 있는데, 다른 뿔 하나가 그 사이에서 돋아나는 것이 보였다. 그것은 작은 뿔이었다. 그 뿔이 자랄 자리를 만들려고 처음 뿔 가운데 셋이 뽑혔다. 이 작은 뿔에는 사람의 눈 같은 눈들이 있었고, 큰소리치는 입이 있었다.

decisions.choice: the small horn: a king who rises from the fourth kingdom (verses 24-25)
decisions.reason: The angel explains the horn as a king who comes after the ten, brings down three, speaks against the Most High and persecutes the holy ones (verses 24-25). In the reading that takes the fourth kingdom as Greece, he is usually identified with Antiochus IV Epiphanes, the Seleucid king who persecuted the Jews in 167-164 BC, as the small horn of 8:9 is. Christian tradition has often read him as a final enemy of God at the end of history (compare 2 Thessalonians 2:3-4). The text names no one.

decisions.choice: a mouth speaking great things: boasting, arrogant speech
decisions.reason: "Great things" are proud claims. Verse 25 says that he will speak against the Most High. Revelation 13:5 gives the beast "a mouth speaking great things and blasphemies".

decisions.choice: eyes like human eyes: intelligence and watchfulness
decisions.reason: The eyes set this horn apart from the others as shrewd and watchful. The angel does not explain them; 8:23 speaks of a king "skilled in intrigue".

decisions.choice: spoke boastfully (B); was boasting (R)
decisions.reason: Literal keeps "speaking great things"; Balanced and Readable say what it means (m2). Readable says "pulled out" for the uprooted horns.

decisions.choice: "otro cuerno, uno pequeño" (L, B); "un cuerno pequeño" (R)
decisions.reason: "El cuerno pequeño" is the book-wide name for this horn (7:8; 8:9)

decisions.choice: sừng; cái sừng nhỏ
decisions.reason: The horns are kept as horns at every level, with no explanation in the text; the interpreter says in verse 24 that they are kings, as the English leaves it.

decisions.choice: "뿔", "작은 뿔" at every level
decisions.reason: The term sheet keeps the vision's images (beasts, horns, kingdoms) as images at every level; the meaning decisions and the angel's words in 7:24 say what they stand for.

source.text: חָזֵ֣ה הֲוֵ֗ית עַ֣ד דִּ֤י כָרְסָוָן֙ רְמִ֔יו וְעַתִּ֥יק יוֹמִ֖ין יְתִ֑ב לְבוּשֵׁ֣הּ׀כִּתְלַ֣ג חִוָּ֗ר וּשְׂעַ֤ר רֵאשֵׁהּ֙ כַּעֲמַ֣ר נְקֵ֔א כָּרְסְיֵהּ֙ שְׁבִיבִ֣ין דִּי־נ֔וּר גַּלְגִּלּ֖וֹהִי נ֥וּר דָּלִֽק׃

records.literal_gloss: Seeing I was until that thrones were placed, and [one] ancient of days sat; his clothing like snow white, and [the] hair of his head like wool pure; his throne [was] flames of fire, its wheels fire burning.

en.L: I kept looking until thrones were put in place, \q and the Ancient of Days sat down. \q His garment was white like snow, and the hair of {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} head like clean wool; \q {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} throne was flames of fire, \q its wheels burning fire.
en.B: As I watched, thrones were put in place, \q and the Ancient of Days was seated. \q His clothes were white as snow, and the hair of {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} head like clean wool. \q His throne was flames of fire, \q and its wheels were blazing fire.
en.R: As I watched, thrones were set up, \q and the Ancient One sat down on {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} throne. \q His clothes were as white as snow, and the hair on {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} head was like clean wool. \q His throne was made of flames of fire, \q and its wheels were burning with fire.

fr.L: Je regardais jusqu’au moment où des trônes furent placés, \q et l’Ancien des jours s’assit. \q Son vêtement était blanc comme la neige, et les cheveux de {{deity_pronoun:sa|Sa}} tête comme de la laine pure ; \q {{deity_pronoun:son|Son}} trône était des flammes de feu, \q ses roues un feu ardent.
fr.B: Tandis que je regardais, des trônes furent installés, \q et l’Ancien des jours prit place. \q Ses vêtements étaient blancs comme la neige, et les cheveux de {{deity_pronoun:sa|Sa}} tête comme de la laine pure. \q Son trône était fait de flammes de feu, \q et ses roues étaient un feu ardent.
fr.R: Pendant que je regardais, des trônes ont été installés, \q et l’Ancien des jours s’est assis sur {{deity_pronoun:son|Son}} trône. \q Ses vêtements étaient aussi blancs que la neige, et les cheveux de {{deity_pronoun:sa|Sa}} tête étaient comme de la laine pure. \q Son trône était fait de flammes de feu, \q et ses roues brûlaient d’un feu ardent.

es.L: Estuve mirando hasta que fueron puestos tronos, \q y se sentó el Anciano de Días. \q Su vestidura era blanca como la nieve, y el cabello de {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} cabeza como lana limpia; \q {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} trono, llamas de fuego, \q y sus ruedas, fuego ardiente.
es.B: Mientras yo miraba, se colocaron unos tronos, \q y el Anciano de Días se sentó. \q Su ropa era blanca como la nieve, y el cabello de {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} cabeza, como lana limpia. \q Su trono era de llamas de fuego, \q y sus ruedas, de fuego ardiente.
es.R: Mientras yo miraba, se colocaron unos tronos, \q y el Anciano se sentó en {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} trono. \q Su ropa era tan blanca como la nieve, y el cabello de {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} cabeza era como lana limpia. \q Su trono estaba hecho de llamas de fuego, \q y sus ruedas ardían en fuego.

vi.L: Tôi cứ nhìn cho đến khi các ngai được đặt, \q và Đấng Thượng Cổ ngồi xuống. \q Áo {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} trắng như tuyết, và tóc trên đầu {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} như lông chiên tinh sạch; \q ngai {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} là những ngọn lửa, \q các bánh xe của nó là lửa cháy.
vi.B: Trong khi tôi nhìn, các ngai được đặt vào chỗ, \q và Đấng Thượng Cổ ngồi trên ngai. \q Áo {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} trắng như tuyết, tóc trên đầu {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} như lông chiên tinh sạch. \q Ngai {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} là những ngọn lửa, \q và các bánh xe của ngai là lửa cháy rực.
vi.R: Trong khi tôi nhìn, các ngai được dựng lên, \q và Đấng Cao Niên ngồi trên ngai {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}. \q Áo {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} trắng như tuyết, và tóc trên đầu {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} như lông chiên tinh sạch. \q Ngai {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} làm bằng những ngọn lửa, \q và các bánh xe của ngai đang cháy rực.

ko.L: 내가 보고 있었는데, 마침내 왕좌들이 놓였고, \q 옛적부터 계신 분께서 앉으셨다. \q 그분의 옷은 눈처럼 희고, 그분의 머리털은 깨끗한 양털 같았다. \q 그분의 왕좌는 불꽃이었고, \q 그 바퀴들은 타오르는 불이었다.
ko.B: 내가 보고 있는데, 왕좌들이 놓이고 \q 옛적부터 계신 분께서 자리에 앉으셨다. \q 그분의 옷은 눈처럼 희고, 머리털은 깨끗한 양털 같았다. \q 그분의 왕좌는 불꽃이었고, \q 그 바퀴들은 활활 타는 불이었다.
ko.R: 내가 보고 있는데, 왕좌들이 놓이고 \q 영원히 계신 분께서 왕좌에 앉으셨다. \q 그분의 옷은 눈처럼 희었고, 머리털은 깨끗한 양털 같았다. \q 그분의 왕좌는 불꽃으로 되어 있었고, \q 그 바퀴들은 불이 붙어 타고 있었다.

decisions.choice: the Ancient of Days: God, pictured as an aged judge on his throne
decisions.reason: The words mean "one advanced in days", an old man. They are a description, not a name: there is no article in 7:9, and the same figure is called "the Ancient of Days" in verses 13 and 22. In the scene he is the judge on the throne, served by thousands (verse 10), and verse 22 shows that he gives the kingdom to the holy ones of the Most High. Age here stands for wisdom, authority and endless life. He is God, though the vision does not use the name.

decisions.choice: white clothing and hair like wool: purity and great age
decisions.reason: White clothes are a sign of purity and of heavenly glory, and white hair a sign of age and honor (Proverbs 16:31). Revelation 1:14 gives the same white hair, like wool and snow, to the risen Jesus.

decisions.choice: a throne of fire with wheels: the chariot-throne of Ezekiel 1 and 10
decisions.reason: Ezekiel saw God's throne above wheels and living creatures, with fire flashing among them (Ezekiel 1:13-27; 10:2-6). Fire in the Bible is a sign of God's holy presence and of judgment (Exodus 19:18; Deuteronomy 4:24).

decisions.choice: thrones were set in place: for the court that sits in verse 10
decisions.reason: The thrones are set for the judgment. Verse 10 says that "the court sat". The text does not say who sits on the other thrones; heavenly beings sit with God in judgment elsewhere (1 Kings 22:19; Psalm 89:8). Revelation 4:4 and 20:4 also picture thrones around God's throne.

decisions.choice: verses 9-10 set in lines; the Ancient of Days (L, B), the Ancient One (R); his (deity pronoun)
decisions.reason: The terms note sets 7:9-10 and 13-14 in lines: they are a poem in rhythmic lines within the vision. Daniel's own telling, not a quotation, so no quotation marks. The title follows the table for Daniel: "the Ancient of Days" at Literal and Balanced and "the Ancient One" at Readable. Pronouns for him are the pronouns for God, with the capitalized form as a setting.

decisions.choice: "l'Ancien des jours" at Readable too, where the English Readable says "the Ancient One"; for the whole chapter
decisions.reason: No plain French word carries the title; "l'Ancien" alone would suggest a church elder. French keeps the traditional title at every level, as the term sheet sets it (uncertain: "le Très-Ancien" at Readable).

decisions.choice: "el Anciano de Días" (L, B); "el Anciano" (R)
decisions.reason: God pictured as an aged judge; the title is capitalized and kept apart from the figure of 7:13 at every level. "El Anciano" at R is uncertain

decisions.choice: Đấng Thượng Cổ (L, B); Đấng Cao Niên (R), with "Ngài"
decisions.reason: "Ancient of Days" is "Đấng Thượng Cổ", a short fixed phrase readers know, at Literal and Balanced; Readable says "Đấng Cao Niên", plainer, as the English Readable says "the Ancient One". He is God, so he takes the deity_pronoun "Ngài".

decisions.choice: "옛적부터 계신 분" (L, B); "영원히 계신 분" (R), with -시- and "그분"
decisions.reason: The term sheet's title for the Ancient of Days: God pictured as an aged judge, whom the honorific marks as God where the English uses deity_pronoun spans; the same wording holds at 7:13 and 7:22.

decisions.choice: Verses 9-10 and 13-14 are set in lines at every level, with Korean placing its own breaks
decisions.reason: The English sets these verses as poetry; Korean follows the same division into lines.

source.text: נְהַ֣ר דִּי־נ֗וּר נָגֵ֤ד וְנָפֵק֙ מִן־קֳדָמ֔וֹהִי אֶ֤לֶף אַלְפִין֙ יְשַׁמְּשׁוּנֵּ֔הּ וְרִבּ֥וֹ רִבְבָ֖ן קָֽדָמ֣וֹהִי יְקוּמ֑וּן דִּינָ֥א יְתִ֖ב וְסִפְרִ֥ין פְּתִֽיחוּ׃

records.literal_gloss: A river of fire [was] flowing and coming out from before him; a thousand thousands were serving him, and a myriad myriads before him were standing; the court sat, and books were opened.

en.L: A river of fire was flowing and coming out from before {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}}; \q a thousand thousands were serving {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}}, \q and ten thousand times ten thousand were standing before {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}}. \q The court sat, and books were opened.
en.B: A river of fire was streaming out, flowing from {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} presence. \q Thousands upon thousands served {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}}, \q and countless thousands stood before {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}}. \q The court was seated, and the books were opened.
en.R: A river of fire was flowing out from in front of {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}}. \q Thousands and thousands of servants served {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}}. \q Millions of them stood in front of {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}}. \q The court began its work, and the books were opened.

fr.L: Un fleuve de feu coulait et sortait de devant {{deity_pronoun:lui|Lui}} ; \q mille milliers {{deity_pronoun:le|Le}} servaient, \q et dix mille fois dix mille se tenaient devant {{deity_pronoun:lui|Lui}}. \q Le tribunal siégea, et des livres furent ouverts.
fr.B: Un fleuve de feu jaillissait et coulait de devant {{deity_pronoun:lui|Lui}}. \q Des milliers et des milliers {{deity_pronoun:le|Le}} servaient, \q et des multitudes innombrables se tenaient devant {{deity_pronoun:lui|Lui}}. \q Le tribunal siégea, et les livres furent ouverts.
fr.R: Un fleuve de feu coulait de devant {{deity_pronoun:lui|Lui}}. \q Des milliers et des milliers de serviteurs {{deity_pronoun:le|Le}} servaient. \q Des millions se tenaient devant {{deity_pronoun:lui|Lui}}. \q Le tribunal a commencé son travail, et les livres ont été ouverts.

es.L: Un río de fuego fluía y salía de delante de {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}}; \q millares de millares {{deity_pronoun:le|Le}} servían, \q y miríadas de miríadas estaban de pie delante de {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}}. \q El tribunal se sentó, y los libros fueron abiertos.
es.B: Un río de fuego corría, brotando de {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} presencia. \q Miles y miles {{deity_pronoun:le|Le}} servían, \q e incontables millares estaban de pie delante de {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}}. \q El tribunal tomó asiento, y se abrieron los libros.
es.R: Un río de fuego salía de delante de {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}}. \q Miles y miles de siervos {{deity_pronoun:le|Le}} servían. \q Millones de ellos estaban de pie delante de {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}}. \q El tribunal comenzó su trabajo, y se abrieron los libros.

vi.L: Một dòng sông lửa tuôn chảy và đi ra từ trước mặt {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}; \q hàng ngàn ngàn [đấng] phục vụ {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}, \q và muôn muôn [đấng] đứng trước mặt {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}. \q Tòa án ngồi xử, và các sách được mở ra.
vi.B: Một dòng sông lửa tuôn chảy ra từ trước mặt {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}. \q Hàng ngàn ngàn đấng phục vụ {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}, \q và muôn muôn đấng đứng chầu trước mặt {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}. \q Tòa án đã an tọa, và các sách được mở ra.
vi.R: Một dòng sông lửa chảy ra từ trước mặt {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}. \q Hàng ngàn hàng ngàn người hầu phục vụ {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}. \q Hàng triệu người đứng trước mặt {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}. \q Tòa án bắt đầu xét xử, và các sách được mở ra.

ko.L: 불의 강이 그분 앞에서 흘러나오고 있었다. \q 천천이 그분을 섬기고 있었고, \q 만만이 그분 앞에 서 있었다. \q 재판정이 열리고, 책들이 펼쳐졌다.
ko.B: 불의 강이 그분 앞에서 흘러나왔다. \q 수천수만이 그분을 섬기고, \q 셀 수 없이 많은 이들이 그분 앞에 서 있었다. \q 재판정이 열리고, 책들이 펼쳐졌다.
ko.R: 그분 앞에서 불의 강이 흘러나왔다. \q 수천수만의 종들이 그분을 섬겼다. \q 셀 수 없이 많은 이들이 그분 앞에 서 있었다. \q 재판이 시작되고, 책들이 펼쳐졌다.

decisions.choice: a thousand thousands, a myriad of myriads: a number past counting
decisions.reason: A myriad is ten thousand. The numbers are not meant to be added up: they say that God's attendants are beyond counting. Revelation 5:11 describes the angels around the throne in the same words.

decisions.choice: the court sat: the heavenly court took its seats for judgment
decisions.reason: The word means judgment, and here the court that gives it. It sits again in verse 26, where the small horn's rule is taken away.

decisions.choice: books were opened: the records of what people have done
decisions.reason: The books are the record by which the court judges. Compare 12:1, where the names of God's people are written in a book, and Revelation 20:12, where "books were opened" and the dead are judged by what is written in them.

decisions.choice: Thousands upon thousands; countless thousands (B); Thousands and thousands; Millions (R)
decisions.reason: Literal keeps the Aramaic numbers. Balanced and Readable give their sense, a host past counting (m1). Readable adds "of servants" so that it is clear these are attendants, and says "began its work" for "sat".

decisions.choice: him, his (deity pronoun)
decisions.reason: These pronouns refer to the Ancient of Days and take the deity_pronoun setting. Balanced says "from his presence" for "from before him".

decisions.choice: "millares de millares ... miríadas de miríadas"
decisions.reason: The words of Revelation 5:11 in Spanish, which takes up this verse

decisions.choice: "천천 … 만만" (L); "수천수만 … 셀 수 없이 많은 이들" (B, R)
decisions.reason: Literal keeps the doubled numbers; the other levels give their sense, a number past counting.

source.text: חָזֵ֣ה הֲוֵ֔ית בֵּאדַ֗יִן מִן־קָל֙ מִלַּיָּ֣א רַבְרְבָתָ֔א דִּ֥י קַרְנָ֖א מְמַלֱּלָ֑ה חָזֵ֣ה הֲוֵ֡ית עַד֩ דִּ֨י קְטִילַ֤ת חֵֽיוְתָא֙ וְהוּבַ֣ד גִּשְׁמַ֔הּ וִיהִיבַ֖ת לִיקֵדַ֥ת אֶשָּֽׁא׃

records.literal_gloss: Seeing I was then, because of [the] sound of the words the great that the horn [was] speaking; seeing I was until that was killed the beast, and was destroyed its body, and it was given to [the] burning of the fire.

en.L: I kept looking then because of the sound of the great words that the horn was speaking. I kept looking until the beast was killed, and its body was destroyed and given over to the burning fire.
en.B: I kept watching because of the boastful words the horn was speaking. As I watched, the beast was put to death, and its body was destroyed and thrown into the blazing fire.
en.R: I kept watching because the horn was still speaking those boastful words. As I watched, the fourth animal was killed. Its body was destroyed and thrown into the fire to burn.

fr.L: Je regardais alors, à cause du bruit des grandes paroles que la corne prononçait. Je regardais jusqu’au moment où la bête fut tuée, et son corps détruit et livré au feu pour être brûlé.
fr.B: Je continuai à regarder, à cause des paroles arrogantes que prononçait la corne. Tandis que je regardais, la bête fut mise à mort ; son corps fut détruit et jeté dans le feu ardent.
fr.R: J’ai continué à regarder, parce que la corne continuait à dire ces paroles pleines d’orgueil. Pendant que je regardais, le quatrième animal a été tué. Son corps a été détruit et jeté dans le feu pour y brûler.

es.L: Seguí mirando entonces a causa del sonido de las grandes palabras que hablaba el cuerno. Estuve mirando hasta que mataron a la bestia, y su cuerpo fue destruido y entregado al fuego ardiente.
es.B: Seguí mirando a causa de las palabras arrogantes que hablaba el cuerno. Mientras yo miraba, mataron a la bestia, y su cuerpo fue destruido y arrojado al fuego ardiente.
es.R: Seguí mirando porque el cuerno seguía diciendo aquellas palabras llenas de orgullo. Mientras yo miraba, mataron al cuarto animal. Su cuerpo fue destruido y echado al fuego para que se quemara.

vi.L: Bấy giờ tôi cứ nhìn vì tiếng những lời lớn lối mà cái sừng đang nói. Tôi cứ nhìn cho đến khi con thú bị giết, và thân thể nó bị hủy diệt và bị phó cho lửa thiêu đốt.
vi.B: Tôi cứ nhìn vì những lời khoác lác mà cái sừng đang nói. Trong khi tôi nhìn, con thú bị giết, thân thể nó bị hủy diệt và bị ném vào lửa cháy rực.
vi.R: Tôi cứ nhìn vì cái sừng vẫn đang nói những lời khoác lác. Trong khi tôi nhìn, con thú thứ tư bị giết. Thân thể nó bị hủy diệt và bị ném vào lửa cho cháy tiêu.

ko.L: 그때에 내가 그 뿔이 말하는 큰 말들의 소리 때문에 보고 있었다. 내가 보고 있었는데, 마침내 그 짐승이 죽임을 당했고, 그 몸은 멸망하여 타는 불에 넘겨졌다.
ko.B: 그때 나는 그 뿔이 큰소리치는 말 때문에 계속 지켜보았다. 내가 보고 있는데, 그 짐승이 죽임을 당하고, 그 몸은 망가져 타는 불 속에 던져졌다.
ko.R: 그 뿔이 여전히 큰소리를 치고 있었기 때문에 나는 계속 지켜보았다. 내가 보고 있는데, 넷째 짐승이 죽임을 당했다. 그 몸은 망가져서 불에 던져져 탔다.

decisions.choice: because of the sound of the great words: Daniel keeps watching because the horn goes on boasting
alternatives: I kept looking from the time of the sound of the great words ...
decisions.reason: The first "I kept looking" stands on its own, and the rest gives the reason: the horn's arrogant words held his attention. Some take the words with what follows: he watched, from the time the horn spoke, until the beast was slain. The sense is close either way: the boasting goes on to the very moment of judgment.

decisions.choice: the beast killed and given to the fire: the end of the fourth kingdom
decisions.reason: The fourth beast is destroyed outright, unlike the others (verse 12). Revelation 19:20 has the beast and the false prophet thrown alive into the lake of fire.

decisions.choice: the fourth animal (R)
decisions.reason: Readable says which beast is meant; the context shows it is the fourth, which bears the horn.

source.text: וּשְׁאָר֙ חֵֽיוָתָ֔א הֶעְדִּ֖יו שָׁלְטָנְה֑וֹן וְאַרְכָ֧ה בְחַיִּ֛ין יְהִ֥יבַת לְה֖וֹן עַד־זְמַ֥ן וְעִדָּֽן׃

records.literal_gloss: And the rest of the beasts, they removed their dominion, and a lengthening in life was given to them until a season and a time.

en.L: And the rest of the beasts: their dominion was removed, but a lengthening of life was given to them for a season and a time.
en.B: The other beasts had their authority taken away, but they were allowed to go on living for a set period of time.
en.R: The other animals had their power to rule taken away. But they were allowed to live on for a while.

fr.L: Et le reste des bêtes : leur domination fut ôtée, mais une prolongation de vie leur fut donnée jusqu’à un temps et un moment.
fr.B: Les autres bêtes se virent retirer leur pouvoir, mais il leur fut permis de vivre encore pendant un temps fixé.
fr.R: Les autres animaux ont perdu leur pouvoir de régner. Mais on leur a permis de vivre encore un peu de temps.

es.L: Y a las demás bestias se les quitó su dominio, pero se les dio prolongación de vida hasta un plazo y un tiempo.
es.B: A las otras bestias se les quitó su autoridad, pero se les permitió seguir viviendo por un tiempo determinado.
es.R: A los otros animales se les quitó el poder de gobernar. Pero se les permitió seguir viviendo por un tiempo.

vi.L: Còn những con thú khác thì quyền thống trị của chúng bị cất đi, nhưng mạng sống chúng được kéo dài thêm một thời kỳ và một thời gian.
vi.B: Các con thú khác bị tước quyền cai trị, nhưng được cho sống thêm một thời gian đã định.
vi.R: Các con thú khác bị lấy mất quyền cai trị. Nhưng chúng được cho sống thêm một thời gian nữa.

ko.L: 그리고 나머지 짐승들은 그들의 통치권을 빼앗겼으나, 그들에게 생명의 연장이 정해진 때와 시기까지 주어졌다.
ko.B: 나머지 짐승들은 권세를 빼앗겼지만, 정해진 기간 동안 계속 살아 있게 되었다.
ko.R: 다른 짐승들은 다스리는 힘을 빼앗겼다. 그러나 얼마 동안은 계속 살 수 있었다.

decisions.choice: they removed: their dominion was taken away
decisions.reason: As in verse 5, a plural verb with no subject says that something was done without naming who did it.

decisions.choice: for a season and a time: for a set time, fixed by God
decisions.reason: The two words are near synonyms and together mean a period that God has appointed. The earlier kingdoms lose their power, but their peoples go on for a while; only the fourth beast is destroyed (verse 11). Compare 2:21: God "changes times and seasons".

decisions.choice: for a set period of time (B); for a while (R)
decisions.reason: Literal keeps "for a season and a time"; Balanced and Readable give its sense (m2).

source.text: חָזֵ֤ה הֲוֵית֙ בְּחֶזְוֵ֣י לֵֽילְיָ֔א וַאֲרוּ֙ עִם־עֲנָנֵ֣י שְׁמַיָּ֔א כְּבַ֥ר אֱנָ֖שׁ אָתֵ֣ה הֲוָ֑ה וְעַד־עַתִּ֤יק יֽוֹמַיָּא֙ מְטָ֔ה וּקְדָמ֖וֹהִי הַקְרְבֽוּהִי׃

records.literal_gloss: Seeing I was in [the] visions of the night, and look, with [the] clouds of the heavens [one] like a son of man was coming; and to the ancient of days he reached, and before him they brought him near.

en.L: I kept looking in the visions of the night, \q and look, with the clouds of the heavens \q [one] like a son of man was coming, \q and he reached the Ancient of Days, \q and they brought him close before {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}}.
en.B: As I watched in the visions of the night, \q I saw one like a son of man \q coming with the clouds of heaven. \q He came to the Ancient of Days \q and was presented before {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}}.
en.R: As I watched in my visions during the night, \q I saw someone who looked like a human being. \q He was coming with the clouds of the sky. \q He came to the Ancient One \q and was led into {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} presence.

fr.L: Je regardais dans les visions de la nuit, \q et voici, avec les nuées du ciel \q venait [quelqu’un] semblable à un fils d’homme ; \q il parvint jusqu’à l’Ancien des jours, \q et on le fit approcher devant {{deity_pronoun:lui|Lui}}.
fr.B: Tandis que je regardais dans les visions de la nuit, \q je vis quelqu’un qui ressemblait à un fils d’homme \q venir avec les nuées du ciel. \q Il s’avança jusqu’à l’Ancien des jours \q et fut présenté devant {{deity_pronoun:lui|Lui}}.
fr.R: Pendant que je regardais dans mes visions de la nuit, \q j’ai vu quelqu’un qui ressemblait à un être humain. \q Il venait avec les nuages du ciel. \q Il est arrivé jusqu’à l’Ancien des jours \q et on l’a conduit devant {{deity_pronoun:lui|Lui}}.

es.L: Estuve mirando en las visiones de la noche, \q y he aquí, con las nubes de los cielos \q venía [uno] semejante a un hijo de hombre; \q y llegó hasta el Anciano de Días, \q y lo llevaron cerca, delante de {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}}.
es.B: Mientras yo miraba en las visiones de la noche, \q vi a uno semejante a un hijo de hombre, \q que venía con las nubes del cielo. \q Llegó hasta el Anciano de Días \q y fue presentado delante de {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}}.
es.R: Mientras yo miraba en mis visiones durante la noche, \q vi a alguien que parecía un ser humano. \q Venía con las nubes del cielo. \q Llegó hasta donde estaba el Anciano \q y lo llevaron a {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} presencia.

vi.L: Tôi cứ nhìn trong các khải tượng ban đêm, \q và kìa, với các đám mây của trời, \q [một vị] giống như con người đang đến, \q và vị ấy đến cùng Đấng Thượng Cổ, \q và người ta đưa vị ấy đến gần trước mặt {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}.
vi.B: Trong khi tôi nhìn trong các khải tượng ban đêm, \q tôi thấy một vị giống như con người \q đang đến với những đám mây trời. \q Vị ấy đến cùng Đấng Thượng Cổ \q và được đưa đến trước mặt {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}.
vi.R: Trong khi tôi nhìn trong các khải tượng ban đêm, \q tôi thấy một vị trông giống như một con người. \q Vị ấy đang đến cùng những đám mây trên bầu trời. \q Vị ấy đến cùng Đấng Cao Niên \q và được đưa vào trước mặt {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}.

ko.L: 내가 밤의 환상들 가운데 보고 있었는데, \q 보라, 하늘의 구름과 함께 \q 인자 같은 이가 오고 있었다. \q 그가 옛적부터 계신 분께 이르렀고, \q 그는 그분 앞으로 인도되었다.
ko.B: 내가 밤의 환상 가운데 보니, \q 인자 같은 이가 \q 하늘의 구름을 타고 오고 있었다. \q 그가 옛적부터 계신 분께 나아가 \q 그분 앞에 섰다.
ko.R: 내가 밤의 환상 가운데 보니, \q 사람처럼 보이는 이가 있었다. \q 그는 하늘의 구름과 함께 오고 있었다. \q 그가 영원히 계신 분께 나아가 \q 그분 앞으로 인도되었다.

decisions.choice: one like a son of man: a figure in human form
decisions.reason: In Aramaic "son of man" means a human being (4:13, 22; Psalm 8:5). "Like" marks a likeness, as "like a lion" and "like a bear" do in verses 4-5. After four beasts from the sea comes one who looks human, coming with the clouds. The words describe what Daniel saw; they are not yet a title. The figure is not God, since he is brought to the Ancient of Days, and he is kept distinct from him.

decisions.choice: the one like a son of man, the holy ones, and Jesus as the Son of Man
decisions.reason: Three things are true of this verse. First, Jesus takes the phrase as his title "the Son of Man" and speaks of himself as coming with or on the clouds of heaven (Matthew 24:30; 26:64; Mark 13:26; 14:62), and Revelation 1:7 and 1:13 see the risen Jesus in Daniel's words. Second, the angel's explanation in verses 16-27 speaks of the kingdom being given to "the holy ones of the Most High" (verses 18, 22, 27), as it is given here to this figure (verse 14). Third, readers differ on how the two relate: the figure may stand for the holy ones as a group, or be their heavenly leader or representative, or be a messianic king; Jewish and Christian interpreters have read him as the Messiah. The translation keeps the vision's description and does not settle the question.

decisions.choice: coming with the clouds ... to the Ancient of Days: coming into God's presence
decisions.reason: In the vision the figure comes with the clouds to the Ancient of Days, so the movement is toward God's throne, where he receives a kingdom (verse 14). Clouds go with the coming of God himself elsewhere (Psalm 104:3; Isaiah 19:1). Jesus' words before the high priest join this verse to Psalm 110:1 (Mark 14:62).

decisions.choice: [one] like a son of man (L); one like a son of man (B); someone who looked like a human being (R); lowercase, with no deity pronoun
decisions.reason: The wording follows the table for Daniel. Every level keeps it in lowercase, because in the vision it is a description, not a name (m1), and the pronouns for this figure ("he", "him") take no deity_pronoun span, as for the servant in Isaiah. The Ancient of Days and this figure are kept distinct: "before him" at the end of the verse is the Ancient of Days, and that pronoun is God's. Readable gives the meaning of "son of man"; the Gospels' title is explained in m2.

decisions.choice: verses 13-14 set in lines
decisions.reason: The terms note sets 7:13-14 in lines, like 7:9-10. Readable says "led into his presence" for "brought near before him"; that pronoun is the Ancient One's and takes the deity_pronoun setting.

decisions.choice: "[quelqu'un] semblable à un fils d'homme" (L), "quelqu'un qui ressemblait à un fils d'homme" (B), "quelqu'un qui ressemblait à un être humain" (R); lowercase and with no deity_pronoun span; "les nuées du ciel" (L, B), "les nuages du ciel" (R)
decisions.reason: In the vision this is a description, as the English keeps it; French uses the words of the published Revelation 1:13 and Matthew 24:30, so that the reader can see where Jesus takes up the phrase, which the meaning decision explains. "Le Fils de l'homme" with capitals is kept for Jesus's title.

decisions.choice: "[uno] semejante a un hijo de hombre" (L); "uno semejante a un hijo de hombre" (B); "alguien que parecía un ser humano" (R)
decisions.reason: Worded as Revelation 1:13 in Spanish ("uno semejante a un hijo de hombre"); lowercase and with no deity_pronoun span, because in the vision this is a description, not the Gospels' title "el Hijo del Hombre" (Matthew 24:30; 26:64). "Con las nubes del cielo" as Revelation 1:7 "viene con las nubes"

decisions.choice: [một vị] giống như con người (L); một vị giống như con người (B); một vị trông giống như một con người (R); lowercase, with "vị ấy" and no span
alternatives: một Đấng giống như con người
decisions.reason: In the vision this is a description, so "con người" is lowercase and the figure takes no deity_pronoun, which keeps him distinct from the Ancient of Days; "vị" gives him honour without making a title. "Giống như con người" is the wording of Revelation 1:13. Jesus takes the phrase as his title "Con Người" (Matthew 24:30, where he comes "trên những đám mây trời"); the meaning decision gives the readings.

decisions.choice: "인자 같은 이" (L, B); "사람처럼 보이는 이" (R), with no honorific and the pronoun "그"
decisions.reason: In the vision this is a description of a figure in human form, so it takes no -시-, as the English keeps it lowercase with no deity pronoun. "인자 같은" matches the Gospels' title "인자" and Revelation 1:13 so the quotation stays visible, while "이" rather than Revelation's "분" keeps it a description. This differs from Ezekiel's "사람의 아들", God's plain address to a prophet. The footnoted meaning decision gives Jesus's use of the phrase.

decisions.choice: The Ancient of Days keeps the honorific ("계신 분께", "그분 앞"); the one like a son of man does not
decisions.reason: The English keeps the two figures distinct with a deity_pronoun span for one only; Korean marks the same difference with the honorific.

source.text: וְלֵ֨הּ יְהִ֤יב שָׁלְטָן֙ וִיקָ֣ר וּמַלְכ֔וּ וְכֹ֣ל עַֽמְמַיָּ֗א אֻמַיָּ֛א וְלִשָּׁנַיָּ֖א לֵ֣הּ יִפְלְח֑וּן שָׁלְטָנֵ֞הּ שָׁלְטָ֤ן עָלַם֙ דִּֽי־לָ֣א יֶעְדֵּ֔ה וּמַלְכוּתֵ֖הּ דִּי־לָ֥א תִתְחַבַּֽל׃פ

records.literal_gloss: And to him was given dominion and honor and kingdom, and all the peoples, the nations and the languages to him will serve; his dominion [is] a dominion of perpetuity which not will pass away, and his kingdom [one] which not will be destroyed.

en.L: And to him were given dominion, glory and a kingdom, \q so that all the peoples, nations and languages would serve him. \q His dominion is an eternal dominion that will not pass away, \q and his kingdom, one that will not be destroyed.
en.B: He was given authority, glory and kingly power, \q so that all peoples, nations and languages would serve him. \q His authority is an everlasting authority that will never pass away, \q and his kingdom will never be destroyed.
en.R: He was given authority, glory and a kingdom. \q People from every nation and language would serve him. \q His authority will last forever. It will never end. \q His kingdom will never be destroyed.

fr.L: Et à lui furent donnés la domination, la gloire et un royaume, \q pour que tous les peuples, nations et langues le servent. \q Sa domination est une domination éternelle qui ne passera pas, \q et son royaume, un [royaume] qui ne sera pas détruit.
fr.B: Il reçut le pouvoir, la gloire et la royauté, \q pour que tous les peuples, nations et gens de toutes langues le servent. \q Son pouvoir est un pouvoir éternel qui ne passera jamais, \q et son royaume ne sera jamais détruit.
fr.R: Il a reçu le pouvoir, la gloire et un royaume. \q Les gens de toute nation et de toute langue le serviraient. \q Son pouvoir durera pour toujours. Il ne finira jamais. \q Son royaume ne sera jamais détruit.

es.L: Y a él se le dio dominio, gloria y reino, \q para que todos los pueblos, naciones y lenguas lo sirvieran. \q Su dominio es un dominio perpetuo, que no se acabará, \q y su reino, [un reino] que jamás será destruido.
es.B: Se le dio autoridad, gloria y poder real, \q para que todos los pueblos, naciones y lenguas lo sirvieran. \q Su autoridad es una autoridad eterna que nunca se acabará, \q y su reino jamás será destruido.
es.R: Se le dio autoridad, gloria y un reino. \q La gente de todas las naciones y lenguas lo serviría. \q Su autoridad durará para siempre. Nunca tendrá fin. \q Su reino nunca será destruido.

vi.L: Và vị ấy được ban cho quyền thống trị, vinh quang và vương quốc, \q để mọi dân tộc, quốc gia và ngôn ngữ đều phục vụ vị ấy. \q Quyền thống trị của vị ấy là quyền thống trị đời đời, không bao giờ qua đi, \q và vương quốc của vị ấy là [vương quốc] không bao giờ bị hủy diệt.
vi.B: Vị ấy được ban cho quyền cai trị, vinh quang và vương quyền, \q để mọi dân tộc, quốc gia và người thuộc mọi ngôn ngữ đều phục vụ vị ấy. \q Quyền cai trị của vị ấy là quyền cai trị đời đời, không bao giờ qua đi, \q và vương quốc của vị ấy sẽ không bao giờ bị hủy diệt.
vi.R: Vị ấy được ban cho quyền cai trị, vinh quang và một vương quốc. \q Mọi người thuộc mọi dân tộc và ngôn ngữ sẽ phục vụ vị ấy. \q Quyền cai trị của vị ấy sẽ còn mãi mãi. Nó sẽ không bao giờ chấm dứt. \q Vương quốc của vị ấy sẽ không bao giờ bị hủy diệt.

ko.L: 그리고 그에게 통치권과 영광과 나라가 주어져서, \q 모든 백성들과 민족들과 언어들이 그를 섬기게 되었다. \q 그의 통치권은 사라지지 않을 영원한 통치권이고, \q 그의 나라는 멸망하지 않을 [나라]이다.
ko.B: 그는 권세와 영광과 나라를 받았고, \q 모든 백성과 민족과 언어가 다른 사람들이 그를 섬기게 되었다. \q 그의 권세는 영원한 권세여서 사라지지 않을 것이고, \q 그의 나라는 결코 멸망하지 않을 것이다.
ko.R: 그는 권세와 영광과 나라를 받았다. \q 모든 나라와 모든 언어의 사람들이 그를 섬길 것이다. \q 그의 권세는 영원할 것이다. 결코 끝나지 않을 것이다. \q 그의 나라는 결코 망하지 않을 것이다.

decisions.choice: dominion, honor and kingdom: the right to rule, the glory that goes with it, and the realm itself
decisions.reason: The same words are used of what God gave Nebuchadnezzar (2:37; 5:18). Now they are given to the one like a son of man, and his rule, unlike the beasts', has no end.

decisions.choice: serve: pay homage and service, as to God
decisions.reason: The verb is the one used in Daniel for serving and worshiping a god (3:12, 14, 17-18, 28; 6:17, 21). Verse 27 uses it for the service all dominions give to the kingdom of the holy ones. It need not mean worship in the full sense, but it is the honor due to God.

decisions.choice: all peoples, nations and languages; an everlasting dominion that will not be destroyed
decisions.reason: The same list of all peoples, nations and languages is used in 3:4 and 6:26 of the empire of Babylon and then Persia. The kingdom that will never be destroyed echoes 2:44 and the praise of God in 4:31 and 6:27. Revelation 11:15 and Luke 1:33 take up the kingdom that has no end.

decisions.choice: him, his, lowercase with no deity pronoun
decisions.reason: These pronouns refer to the one like a son of man, and follow the decision at verse 13: the vision describes him, and the wording does not decide who he is. They take no deity_pronoun span.

decisions.choice: authority (B, R); glory (all levels)
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable say "authority" for dominion, as elsewhere in this chapter. The word for honor ("glory" here) is the one paired with greatness in 4:33 and 5:18.

decisions.choice: "통치권과 영광과 나라" (L); "권세와 영광과 나라" (B, R), with no honorific for him
decisions.reason: The three gifts in plain words; the figure who receives them stays without -시-, as the term sheet sets, while the wording of the everlasting kingdom echoes 2:44, 4:31 and 6:27.

records.literal_gloss: Was distressed my spirit, I, Daniel, in [the] midst of [its] sheath, and [the] visions of my head alarmed me.

en.L: As for me, Daniel, my spirit was distressed within its sheath, and the visions of my head alarmed me.
en.B: I, Daniel, was deeply troubled in spirit, and the visions that passed through my mind frightened me.
en.R: I, Daniel, was very upset. The visions I saw in my mind frightened me.

fr.B: Moi, Daniel, j’eus l’esprit profondément troublé, et les visions qui traversaient mon esprit m’effrayèrent.

vi.L: Còn tôi, Đa-ni-ên, tâm thần tôi bối rối trong thân xác, và các khải tượng trong đầu tôi làm tôi kinh hoàng.
